user.title: New room
user.description: Name the room and pick its lights. Steps, brightness and colors are set afterwards in the **Crescendo** editor in the sidebar.

abort.already_configured: This room has already been imported.

init.title: Room settings
init.description: Steps, brightness and colors are edited in the **Crescendo** editor in the sidebar.

data.max_segment: Longest single command during long fades

data_description.default_transition: Used when the room is changed without a transition, e.g. by a dashboard slider.
data_description.max_segment: Long fades are split into commands of at most this length so they can be stopped at any time.

deprecated_yaml.title: Crescendo room "{name}" was imported from YAML
deprecated_yaml.description: The room "{name}" was imported and is now edited in the Crescendo editor in the sidebar. Remove its `cloudless_crescendo` entry from `light:` in your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant. Until then the YAML is ignored.

fade_to.name: Fade to position
fade_to.description: Moves the room along its curve to a position. Every light follows its own staggered curve on the way.

position.name: Position
position.description: Target position on the room's 0–100 scale. 0 turns everything off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the fade takes, e.g. one hour for a wake-up light. Defaults to the room's default transition.

stop.name: Stop fade
stop.description: Stops a running fade and keeps all lights where they currently are.
